name: field_ecology
description: Fresh populations surveyed repeatedly within each experiment, with shared latent site occupancy.
noise_std_semantics: Rigorous marginal standard-deviation upper bounds; not Gaussian standard deviations or exact variances
clean_output_semantics: Exact marginal population expectations; not a realized fixed-population trajectory
interventions_scope: Survey-method and repeat-count changes only; selecting habitat is sampling, not causal intervention on habitat
public_contract: Only describe() and independently sampled public survey observations are candidate-facing; clean means, hidden probabilities, seeds, source and strata are operator-only.
version_policy: Explicit replicated-population adaptation; not a persistent fixed-site or spatial-survey environment. Historical cohorts and scores remain unchanged.
